# Nordstorm.com Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/nordstorm-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/nordstorm-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects product listing data from Nordstorm.com, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape Nordstrom Fashion Product Data](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-nordstrom)
- **Code:** [`nordstorm.py`](nordstorm.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Product pages](results/products.json) · [Search pages](results/search.json)

## What it scrapes

- Nordstorm product pages
- Nordstorm search pages

## Functions

- `scrape_products(urls)`: scrape nordstorm product pages for product data
- `scrape_search(url, max_pages=10)` → `List[Dict]`: Scrape nordstom search pages for product listings

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import nordstorm


async def main():
    products = await nordstorm.scrape_products(
        urls=[
            "https://www.nordstrom.com/s/nike-air-max-90-sneaker-men/6549520",
            "https://www.nordstrom.com/s/hank-kent-performance-twill-dress-shirt-regular-big/7783670",
        ],
    )
    search = await nordstorm.scrape_search(
        url="https://www.nordstrom.com/sr?origin=keywordsearch&keyword=indigo",
        max_pages=2,
    )


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields of the sample output (top-level keys of the first item):

- [`results/products.json`](results/products.json): `id`, `title`, `description`, `features`, `type`, `typeParent`, `reviewAverageRating`, `numberOfReviews`, `brand`, `gender`, `media`, `variants`
- [`results/search.json`](results/search.json): `id`, `sellingBrand`, `legacyStyleGroupId`, `webPathAlias`, `copyProductTitle`, `copyDescription`, `defaultCoreChoice`, `labelId`, `labelDisplayName`, `propositions`, `coreProducts`, `partnerRelationships`, `reviews`

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`nordstorm.py`](nordstorm.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `asp` = `True`: Anti Scraping Protection, the earlier name of the [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker)
- `country` = `"US"`: country of the proxy
- `render_js` = `True`: render the page in a real browser
- `proxy_pool` = `"public_residential_pool"`: proxy pool (datacenter or residential)

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/nordstorm-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_product_scraping`, `test_search_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
